summary: Iteration 4 tested Phase-3: per-company 1C connection, Soliq Excel import + matching, receipt manual match, approvals workflow, and role isolation (backend) + full UI flow (frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase3.py: 15 passed, 1 skipped (needs_review receipt not available after prior matching) — 100% of executed tests pass. Verified: (1) PUT/GET /api/companies/{cid}/one-c stores password encrypted, returns has_password=true, NEVER returns password or password_enc; (2) POST /one-c/test hits real clobus.uz and returns ok=false with reason '1C HTTP 401: autentifikatsiya rad etildi', company one_c_status='error'; (3) POST /one-c/sync-products returns 400 for unconfigured/error connection; (4) DELETE resets connection; (5) POST /companies/{cid}/soliq/upload creates receipts (created=2, duplicates counted on reupload, Қайтариш rows skipped, non-soliq xlsx -> 400); (6) matching by mxik/name works — receipts with all matched items get status=matched, rest needs_review; (7) POST /api/receipt-items/{id}/match sets item high, creates product_mapping, receipt transitions to matched; (8) POST /companies/{cid}/receipts/import-1c creates pending action; (9) GET /api/actions?status=pending lists it; (10) approve -> failed with 1C auth error (expected with fake creds); (11) reject -> rejected; (12) role isolation: admin (non-creator) gets 404 on creator's company receipts. Frontend: creator login OK; Kompaniyalar page has 1C button per row (one-c-btn-{id}); OneCDialog opens, save works, test button shows 'one-c-error' with '1C HTTP 401: autentifikatsiya rad etildi. Login/parolni tekshiring.', status badge shows 'error'. Cheklar page: soliq-upload-btn + hidden soliq-file-input uploaded /tmp/soliq_ui.xlsx, receipt rows appeared, opening row rendered receipt-detail-dialog. Checkbox on matched receipt enabled send-to-1c-btn; click created approvals-panel with 1 action; clicking reject-{id} removed row (0 remaining).

issues: Radix DialogContent shown without DialogTitle while data is null (loading state) — console a11y warning.

action_items: (Minor a11y) In ReceiptDetailDialog.jsx render a hidden/placeholder DialogTitle even during loading state to silence the Radix warning (also seen in prior iterations for other dialogs).
critical_code_review_comments: receipts_service.import_soliq_excel returns 'matched' count as number of receipts whose status=='matched' after inserting; correct, but 'needs_review' is computed as created-matched which excludes duplicates — OK. Consider explicit 'needs_review' count for clarity.
one_c_service.public_connection correctly omits password_enc/token_enc from output. Good.

routes.py receipts_import_1c allows pushing receipts already in 'failed' status (retry). That's intentional but ensure UI communicates re-attempt semantics (currently checkbox enabled only for matched/failed — good).
approvals._execute: for import_receipts_batch, sets 'ok': not failed, but individual push_receipt failures don't roll back — expected (best-effort); make sure UI/toast surfaces failed[] list.
api/routes.py is now >720 lines with 1C+soliq+approvals appended — split into per-domain routers (routes/one_c.py, routes/receipts.py, routes/approvals.py) becomes urgent.
one_c_service._fernet reuses JWT_SECRET-derived key — acceptable single-key scheme but consider rotation and key-id header for future migration.
receipts_service.rematch_receipt: when a receipt is already 'imported'/'approved' it still updates items_total/items_matched — good, but status update is skipped correctly.

receipts_service.import_soliq_excel: 'matched_full' count uses find with 'status':'matched' after rematch, but if any receipt lingers as 'parsed' due to no items (should never happen given qty/total checks), count may be off — non-blocking.
manual_match auto-applies mapping to *other* unmatched items with same name — good, but silently no cap; for very large companies could be slow — consider limit.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_Phase3_* company (deleted in fixture teardown), 2 TEST products (Non oq / Sut 1L) inside it, 2 receipts via Soliq xlsx import, and 1 additional matched-then-rejected pending action. Frontend flow uploaded a second /tmp/soliq_ui.xlsx (2-row) into existing TEST_slash_b84007 company and rejected the resulting pending action, so nothing was actually pushed to real 1C.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-3 regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_phase3.py. Real 1C test connection to clobus.uz returns HTTP 401 in ~4-8s — expected. AI chat with propose_action was NOT re-tested this iteration (already covered in iter3 and LLM-dependent). Telegram voice/whisper cannot be tested via HTTP. Combine test_retest.py + test_knowledge.py + test_phase3.py for full backend regression.
